omniroute.name: OmniRoute (local gateway)
omniroute.hint: Hub > OmniRoute me install aur start karo. Agar OmniRoute me API key lagayi hai to wo yahan daalo
omniroute.limits: Khud ka gateway: bahut saare free providers ek endpoint par

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.limits: Free tier, bina card. Limits AI Studio me dikhti hain
gemini.note: Free tier ke prompts Google product sudharne me use kar sakta hai

openrouter.name: OpenRouter (:free models)
openrouter.limits: 20 req/min, 50 req/din sab :free models mila ke (10 credits kharidne par 1000/din)
openrouter.note: Free providers prompts log kar sakte hain
openrouter.hint: Key: openrouter.ai/keys. Filter me free likho

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.limits: Free tier (kai request/min aur din ki limit)

mistral.name: Mistral AI
mistral.note: Free mode me prompts training me use ho sakte hain (opt-out hai)

nvidia.name: NVIDIA NIM
nvidia.note: NVIDIA Developer Program (free) chahiye. Sirf trial/test use, private data mat bhejo

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare.note: URL me {account_id} ki jagah apni Cloudflare Account ID likho (dashboard ke Workers AI page par milti hai)
cloudflare.hint: Token: Workers AI permission wala API token

zai.name: Z AI / Zhipu (GLM Flash)
zai.limits: GLM Flash models free, 1 saath 1 request
zai.note: International site ke liye URL: https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 (wahan alag account/key)

github.name: GitHub Models
github.limits: Free, rate-limited. Har request me chhota input/output limit

huggingface.name: Hugging Face Router
huggingface.limits: Free monthly credits (account ke hisab se)

kilo.name: Kilo Gateway (bina key)
kilo.limits: Free models bina key, 200 req/ghanta per IP
kilo.note: Free pool badalta rehta hai. Kuch models prompts log/train kar sakte hain
kilo.hint: Free models ke liye key nahi chahiye

llm7.name: LLM7.io (bina key)
llm7.limits: Bina key chalta hai. Free token se 60 req/min, 250 req/ghanta
llm7.note: Catalog roz badalta hai. Free limit bina bataye ghat sakti hai
llm7.hint: Key optional: token.llm7.io se free token

ovh.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
ovh.note: EU servers. Bahut slow limit, sirf test ke liye
ovh.hint: Bina key. Limit bahut kam hai

gonka.name: Gonka Broker
gonka.note: Real (non-VoIP) phone number se SMS verify, ek number = ek grant

aion.name: Aion Labs (roleplay)
aion.note: Roleplay/story ke liye bana hai, coding ke liye nahi

modelscope.name: ModelScope (China)
modelscope.note: Alibaba Cloud account + China real-name verification chahiye. Bahar ke log aksar nahi bana paate

siliconflow.name: SiliconFlow (China)
siliconflow.limits: Kuch models permanently free, baaki paid
siliconflow.note: Real-name identity verification chahiye (China documents). International user ko support se baat karni padti hai

ollama.name: Ollama (apne PC par)
ollama.limits: Poora free, apne PC ke hisab se speed
ollama.note: Pehle Ollama install karo aur model pull karo. Termux par practical nahi

openai.name: OpenAI-compatible (direct)
openai.hint: DeepSeek, Mistral wagairah ka URL bhi chalega

sarvam.name: Sarvam AI 🇮🇳 (Indian languages)
sarvam.limits: Naya account par ₹100 free credit (docs ke hisab se). Credits expire nahi hote, khatam hone par top-up
sarvam.hint: Key: dashboard.sarvam.ai > Key Management. Hindi aur 22 Indian languages ke liye achha
sarvam.note: Free credit ke baad paid. Pricing page par numbers badalte rehte hain, dashboard me check karo

sambanova.name: SambaNova Cloud
sambanova.limits: Free tier ke limits account ke hisab se. Kuch sources ise trial bolte hain, isliye pehle Key test karo
sambanova.note: Free status par sources me mismatch hai. Models aur limits dashboard me confirm karo
